themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, education, and social services. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize nationalist agendas at regional and national levels, with notable policy proposals and legislative actions in Spain, Sweden, and Norway.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in housing access, school menus, and social aid, targeting immigrants and unaccompanied minors.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Swedish citizens in welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushes for employment-focused integration policies and opposes immigrant access to social benefits.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes policies to prioritize French citizens in housing and social services, aligning with EU migration reforms.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports EU-wide migration reforms that align with national priority frameworks, including stricter deportation rules.

themes.title: Diplomatic fallout from Trump-Meloni tensions
themes.blurb: A public spat between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has escalated into a diplomatic crisis, with cross-national reactions from far-right leaders. The theme highlights how personal and policy disagreements between allied leaders can strain international relations and trigger domestic political responses.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump publicly insulted Meloni, claiming she begged for a photo at the G7 summit, sparking a diplomatic row.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni strongly denied Trump's claims, calling them fabricated, and received widespread support from Italian leaders.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella expressed solidarity with Meloni, criticizing Trump's remarks as disrespectful to European allies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish leaders condemned Trump's behavior, framing it as an attack on European sovereignty.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal fractures, leadership challenges, and ideological disputes. This theme captures the growing instability within these movements, often driven by personality clashes, policy disagreements, or external pressures such as judicial investigations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces leadership challenges from Roberto Vannacci's new party, which has overtaken Lega in polls.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Experiences infighting between Javier Milei and allies like Ramiro Marra over Manuel Adorni's corruption scandal.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with poor by-election results and internal criticism over candidate selection and messaging.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Deals with internal disputes, expulsions, and controversies over extremist rhetoric among members.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Faces internal shifts as new leadership under Péter Magyar distances itself from Viktor Orbán's legacy.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal dominates Argentine discourse
themes.blurb: The corruption scandal involving Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni has become a defining cross-national theme, drawing reactions from political leaders, media, and the public. The scandal highlights broader concerns about transparency, judicial independence, and the stability of Javier Milei's government.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni faces judicial investigations for illicit enrichment, with allies and opposition demanding his resignation.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Media outlets cover the scandal as a test of Milei's anti-corruption promises and governance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes the scandal as emblematic of broader corruption in Latin American politics, drawing parallels to Spain.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders and parties are responding to escalating conflicts in the Middle East, particularly the Israel-Hezbollah tensions and the U.S.-Iran peace deal. This theme captures their rhetorical framing, policy positions, and diplomatic maneuvers, often reflecting broader geopolitical alliances and ideological stances.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Defends the U.S.-Iran deal as a diplomatic victory, despite criticism from allies and opponents.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticizes the U.S.-Iran deal, aligning with Israeli concerns over regional security.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Expresses skepticism about the U.S.-Iran deal, emphasizing European security interests.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
